technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the increment on the existing Spring XD codebase baseline, keeping its current Java, Spring and Gradle versions; the generic Spring Framework 6 / Java 17 preamble does not trigger any platform upgrade.

U1: Introduce externalized Sqoop metastore configuration properties (metastore JDBC URL, driver class, username, password, metastore location) defaulting to the current embedded HSQLDB-based metastore, and wire them into the Sqoop job/tasklet bootstrap so a custom RDBMS-backed metastore can be plugged in.

U2: Deliver the HDFS-backed module registry as reference documentation only (configuration properties, example xd-admin configuration, and verification steps); the registry feature itself is assumed already implemented per XD-2287.

U3: Add three read-only endpoints (/metrics/counters/all, /metrics/gauges/all, /metrics/rich-gauges/all) to the existing metrics REST controller; the service layer enumerates all entries from the existing metric repositories and returns a JSON map of name-to-value; no pagination or UI dashboard work is included.

U4: Implement the ModuleRunner as a standalone Spring Boot application bootstrapped via SpringApplication; module deployment descriptors (module coordinates, options, bus bindings) are supplied through externalized Boot configuration; transport binding reuses the existing XD message-bus abstraction so the runner works in container-managed environments without xd-container.

U5: Extend the GemFire (GF) source module options with native security properties (security-client-auth-init class, username, password and related gfsecurity properties) and wire them into the ClientCacheFactory used by the source; document where the properties must be set.

U6: Implement the jdbcgpfdist batch job as an OOTB batch job module using the existing batch job infrastructure: a JDBC ItemReader plus a new gpfdist ItemWriter that reuses the gpfdist sink's listener/server components, packaged as a job module XML with module options and README.

U7: Refactor the test infrastructure so repository dependencies are injected into test base classes; mock repository implementations are moved to a dedicated test package and real-repository tests select implementations via configuration, removing hard-coded coupling.

U8: Migrate the Reactor-based data processor module from the spring-xd-modules repository into the core repository preserving the module name for backward compatibility, with Gradle build integration, module registration and reference documentation.
Testing uses JUnit with Spring MVC test support (MockMvc) for REST endpoints and existing XD test utilities; documentation is written into the Asciidoc reference guide.
assumptions: A single senior developer performs all work; estimates are net development effort in work-hours, not elapsed calendar time.
The existing Spring XD codebase is available, builds cleanly, and the development environment (JDK, Gradle, IDE) is already set up.
No HAWQ/GPDB cluster is available; U6 is verified against an embedded/mock gpfdist server with HSQLDB as the JDBC source, which is considered sufficient for this increment.
GemFire artifacts are available via the build; U5 security behavior is verified with a test SecurityManager/AuthInitialize implementation rather than a production LDAP setup.
U2 is documentation-only; the HDFS-backed module registry code (XD-2287) is already implemented and functional.
U4 scope ('Scope: *') is interpreted as a functional Boot-based ModuleRunner with module lifecycle management and bus binding; clustering, failover and admin-UI integration are out of scope.
U3 delivers the REST API only; custom dashboards or other UI consumers are out of scope.

Per-story estimates include implementation, unit tests and minimal module-level documentation; cross-story integration testing, build/CI updates and consolidated reference documentation are separate activities.
Documentation is produced in English in the existing reference guide format; no translation or web publishing work is included.
Self code review is performed by the developer; no external approvals or third-party dependencies block delivery.

activities.activity_description: Analyze the eight user stories against the existing codebase, define the design approach for each story (configuration model, REST endpoints, Boot runner architecture, batch job structure, test refactoring plan, module migration plan) and record decisions.

Add externalized Sqoop metastore properties with defaults, implement metastore configuration wiring in the Sqoop job/tasklet bootstrap, add unit tests with an alternative (H2) metastore database, and update module documentation.
Verify the HDFS-backed module registry configuration steps against a running HDFS and write the recommended configuration into the reference documentation, including property reference and examples.

Implement /metrics/counters/all, /metrics/gauges/all and /metrics/rich-gauges/all endpoints, extend the service layer to enumerate all metrics from the existing repositories, define the JSON representation, add MockMvc tests and REST documentation.

Create the Spring Boot ModuleRunner application: bootstrap, externalized module deployment configuration, module lifecycle (deploy/undeploy/shutdown hooks), message-bus binding via the existing abstraction, logging, integration tests and user documentation for running XD without xd-container.

activities.activity_name: U5: GemFire source with native authentication
activities.activity_description: Extend the GF source module options with native security properties, wire them into the ClientCacheFactory/auth initializer, add tests using a test SecurityManager and AuthInitialize implementation, and document where the GF native and security properties are configured.

Implement a gpfdist batch ItemWriter reusing the gpfdist sink components, define the jdbcgpfdist job module (JDBC reader options, writer options, job XML), package it as an OOTB job with README, and add integration tests with an embedded gpfdist server and HSQLDB source.

Refactor test base classes to inject repository implementations, move mock repositories to a dedicated test package, enable selection of real versus mock repositories via configuration, and update all affected test classes.

activities.activity_name: U8: Migrate Reactor processor module to core
activities.activity_description: Move the Reactor-based data processor module from spring-xd-modules into the core repository, integrate it into the Gradle build, register the module type, adapt packages/tests, preserve backward compatibility, and update documentation.

activities.activity_name: Integration and system testing with defect fixing
activities.activity_description: Run cross-story integration and system tests of the assembled increment (admin runtime, module deployment, metrics endpoints, batch job execution, ModuleRunner), triage and fix defects found, and re-run regression tests.
Extend the Gradle build and CI configuration for new modules and test suites, update distribution packaging to include the new batch job and ModuleRunner, and produce the increment build artifacts.
Consolidate the reference guide updates from all stories, write release notes covering the eight user stories, and perform a final documentation review.
